init_head_provenance: Baseline A step_8000 -- the SOURCE-ONLY linear probe, the 'LP' of LP->FT. Method-neutral and identical on every fold. The same head DANN x nb3 and the lambda=0 arm both use. DISCLOSURE (7.18): the four nb3 arms now initialise from THREE different heads -- CORAL from round-1 CORAL heads, FreeMatch from its own, DANN and BNM from Baseline A's. Pairing across folds removes fold difficulty and does not remove this.

gamma_invariant.invariant: gamma is constant: the value actually multiplied into the loss is bit-stable in its recorded form and stable to 1e-06 relative in its effective form
gamma_invariant.why_the_two_layers_differ: the recorded values involve no arithmetic and are compared for bit-identity; the effective ratio is a float32 product re-widened to float64, whose worst observed deviation over 8000 draws is 7.1e-08 against float32's 6.0e-08 half-ulp, so it gets a relative tolerance of 1e-06 -- ~14x the rounding and ~1e6x below the smallest ramp step the guard exists to catch

budget_rule: 2 x the first fold-0 step at which normalised ||A||_* reaches the sharpening-only ceiling 10.8413 (Stage 0a), NEVER exceeding the declared ceiling of 8000 (7.14's development cap: a confirmatory budget never exceeds the development budget). Two refusal branches -- never crossed, or above the ceiling -- and NEITHER is clamped.
selection_rule: NONE. The budget is the selector; no argmax, no label-free rule.
lr_protocol: zoobot_v2.0.1 defaults per 7.1a: head_lr == top-block lr, lr_decay 0.75, weight_decay 0.05, NO LR schedule. Same values round-4 CORAL and the lambda=0 arm used. Tuning budget: ZERO.
target_holdout_note: BNM has no discriminator and needs no holdout. It is KEPT because the lambda=0 arm is this runner's gamma=0 known-null and reusing it requires the target sampler to match field-for-field (brief 5). It is also a genuine diagnostic here: 7.12 measured the 782 target images being memorised and BNM is the objective most aligned with that, so a slice the loss never saw is the only way to tell generalisation from memorisation.

collapse_band.ceiling_status: ADVISORY ONLY -- logged every checkpoint, read at analysis time against 7.20's healthy-direction prediction, never a gate and never a selection criterion
collapse_band.rationale: Downward from the init heads to the all-negative solution with only the init's own value of room, so the floor is a DRIFT bound and it gates. Upward is the PREDICTED healthy direction (7.20 predicts drift toward ~0.5), so a ceiling tight enough to be a real detector could fire on legitimate behaviour -- and one loose enough that it cannot (0.90) detects only catastrophe. 0.75 is deliberately in the useful range and therefore ADVISORY, which is round 5's abort3b arrangement generalised: a condition that might fire on legitimate behaviour goes advisory rather than being loosened until it cannot fire.

da_hook_slot: Trainer.coral, via bnm_round6.install_bnm at coral_weight=gamma. train_skeleton.py is UNMODIFIED. BNMHook adapts the hook's (src_adapter, tgt_adapter) signature to BNM's target-only objective; the source tensor is ignored and test_bnm_round6.T1 asserts the loss is bit-identical under a different source batch, with CoralLoss as the known-null.
single_gpu: no DataParallel / DDP / device sharding anywhere on this path
hard_gate: NON-SKIPPABLE. The phase-1 head is fold-INDEPENDENT, so the head-norm check proves the right FILE and only the per-fold gate proves the right FOLD.
abort_note: ADVISORY, NEVER ABORTING, on every fold. Round 5's arrangement would have killed all four confirmatory folds at ~step 450.
metric_hygiene: the ONLY test-set metric computed is the step-0 gate; every training segment runs inside test_label_lockout(); checkpoints are SCORED (logits persisted) but never MEASURED
reporting_note: fold 0 is DEVELOPMENT (7.14) and enters no headline. TPR@FPR=1e-3 is a RATE, never counts.

trainedon_probe.why_size_matched: normalised ||A||_* is sqrt(B/C) at a confident state, so it grows with the sample size: 704 vs 78 reads 3.00x higher at IDENTICAL behaviour. An unmatched comparison would report sqrt(B) as memorisation.

cadence: every 25 steps to 500 (STATISTICS ONLY), then every 250 (full evaluation)
